name: Vile Familiars
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Ruzan sends warlock initiates against vile familiars. After you slay them, you report to Zureetha Fargaze, who oversees the effort to curb the Burning Blade.

sections.title: A Matter of Discipline
sections.body: Warriors and scouts in the Valley of Trials answer directly to Zureetha Fargaze, who sends them to curb the Burning Blade Coven. Warlock initiates first answer to Ruzan, their shadowy mentor. He demands proof that you can master lesser demons before sending you back to aid the Horde's defense. Your work serves both the warlocks and the safety of the Den.

sections.title: The Threat of the Coven
sections.body: Zureetha Fargaze watches the northern cavern above the Valley of Trials. Vile familiars hide within, the weakest pets of the Burning Blade cultists. Their presence in the sacred training grounds insults the orcs and threatens the Valley. When you report your success, you show that those who practice fel magic remain ready to defend Durotar from corruption.

faq.q: Why does Ruzan send me to Zureetha Fargaze instead of rewarding me himself?
faq.answer: Zureetha Fargaze coordinates the defense and the effort to cull the Burning Blade in the Valley of Trials. Ruzan tests your control over lesser fel creatures, then sends you to Zureetha so she can recognize your service and fold it into the Valley's defense.
Vile familiars are minor demonic imps and minions bound to the Burning Blade Coven. They serve darker masters deep inside the cavern overlooking the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: Where can I find Zureetha Fargaze?
faq.answer: Zureetha Fargaze is out in the open near the center of the Den in the Valley of Trials, a short walk up from the trainers' camp where Ruzan resides.

faq.q: Why is there another quest with the exact same name?
faq.answer: Most adventurers receive Vile Familiars directly from Zureetha Fargaze and hunt the creatures for her. Warlocks receive a separate task from Ruzan, then report back to Zureetha when they finish.

faq.q: What is the Burning Blade doing in the Valley of Trials?
aliases: why are cultists in the den
faq.answer: The Burning Blade cult operates in secret pockets across Durotar, seeking to undermine Thrall's new Horde from within. From a cavern inside the Valley of Trials, its members prey on unproven novices and spread demonic corruption under the eyes of the orcish overseers.

faq.q: Does slaying these familiars wipe out the cult?
faq.answer: No. The vile familiars are pets and scouts for the darker powers inside the coven. Defeating them is the first step toward uncovering and cleansing the deeper cultist threat in the Valley.

angles.text: As a warlock, you face the vile familiars to prove you can dominate and dismantle wild fel creatures without falling prey to them.
As an orc, you know demonic familiars recall the dark pacts that once enslaved your people. Removing them from Durotar's soil matters to your people's survival.
As a Darkspear troll, you share the Valley of Trials with others who view demonic magic with deep suspicion. You need to show your loyalty by standing against rogue cultists.
